_comment: Weights for the Maritime Supply-Chain Risk Index (MSRI).
The five components are each scaled to 0-1 inside the pipeline; these weights
decide how they trade off against each other. They are a DECLARED JUDGEMENT,
not a measurement: they are kept in this file precisely so that an assessor can
change them and re-run, and so that no weight is hidden inside analysis code.
india_dependency is likewise an analyst-set 0-1 score for how exposed Indian
trade is to each corridor. Rationale for each value is given inline. It is used
only for the India-specific ranking, never for the global MSRI.

hormuz.why: Bulk of India's crude and LPG imports originate inside the Gulf and must transit Hormuz.

persian_gulf.why: Loading ports for the same crude and LPG flows.

gulf_of_oman.why: Immediate approach to Hormuz; Indian-flag and Indian-crewed tankers transit daily.

india_west_coast.why: Kandla, Mumbai, JNPT, Cochin approaches - India's own gateway waters.

sri_lanka_corridor.why: Main east-west lane south of Sri Lanka; India's container transhipment axis.

bab_el_mandeb.why: Suez routing for India-Europe and India-US East Coast trade.

gulf_of_aden.why: Convoy and escort water for Indian-flag shipping; anti-piracy patrol area.

malacca.why: India-East Asia trade and naval deployment route.

singapore_strait.why: Transhipment hub for Indian containerised exports.

bay_of_bengal.why: East-coast ports, coastal shipping and Andaman approaches.

arabian_sea.why: Indian EEZ approaches and fleet operating area.

somali_basin.why: Piracy risk water on the India-Africa route.

cape_of_good_hope.why: Diversion route that Indian trade falls back on when Suez is unusable.

black_sea.why: Sunflower oil and fertiliser imports; a supply concentration rather than a route India sails.

eastern_med.why: Onward leg of the Suez route to European markets.

south_china_sea.why: India-East Asia trade and ONGC Videsh interests off Vietnam.

taiwan_strait.why: Electronics and semiconductor supply into Indian manufacturing.

gibraltar.why: Atlantic leg of India-Europe and India-Americas routes.

sunda.why: Alternative to Malacca if it closes.

gulf_of_guinea.why: Crude imports from Nigeria and Angola; Indian seafarers frequently kidnapped here.
